measures.label: Runs
measures.description: The number of runs in the design.

measures.label: Fits the model?
measures.description: Whether every coefficient of the model can be estimated: the model matrix has full column rank.

measures.label: Residual degrees of freedom
measures.description: The runs left after the fit to estimate the run-to-run noise; counted from the rank of the model matrix when the design cannot fit the model.

measures.label: A/p, average coefficient variance
measures.description: tr(M^-1)/p: the coefficients' variances averaged over the p coefficients, in units of sigma^2.

measures.label: I, average prediction variance
measures.description: tr(M^-1 B): the variance of a prediction averaged over the cube, in units of sigma^2; B holds the averages of the products of the model terms there.

measures.label: E, smallest eigenvalue of M
measures.description: The worst-estimated combination of the coefficients has variance sigma^2 / E.

measures.label: G, largest prediction variance
measures.description: The variance of a prediction at the worst point of the cube, in units of sigma^2.

measures.label: D, |M|^(1/p)
measures.description: The joint precision of all p coefficients: their joint confidence region has a volume proportional to |M|^(-1/2).

measures.label: Max |r| between second-order terms
measures.description: The largest absolute correlation between two second-order terms (squares and two-factor interactions), whether or not the model includes them.

measures.label: Power, main effect
measures.description: The probability that the test of the least precisely estimated main effect is significant when its coefficient is effect_size noise standard deviations.

measures.label: Power, interaction
measures.description: As for the main effect, for the least precisely estimated two-factor interaction.

measures.label: Power, quadratic
measures.description: As for the main effect, for the least precisely estimated pure quadratic.

Rotatable CCD [n=17]: Some runs lie outside the cube [-1, 1], up to 1.68 from the center on a factor, while I and G are computed over the cube.
2^3 [n=8]: Cannot fit the quadratic model: its 10 terms have rank 7 in this design. I(A ** 2), I(B ** 2), I(C ** 2) take the same value in every run, as the intercept does.
The squares do not vary in this design, so max |r| is over the interactions only.
